params.name: id
params.description: The unique ID of the scan or user-defined template (policy).

items.docs:
Gets the configuration details for the scan or user-defined template (policy). **Note:** The returned attributes can vary depending on the Tenable-provided template used to create the scan or user-defined template (policy).
Requires the Standard [32] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: type
params.description: The type of templates to retrieve (scan, policy, or remediation).

items.docs:
Lists Tenable-provided scan templates. Tenable provides a number of scan templates to facilitate the creation of scans and scan policies. For a full description of these scan templates, see the [Scan Templates](https://docs.tenable.com/vulnerability-management/Content/Scans/Templates.htm) in the Tenable Vulnerability Management User Guide.
Requires the Standard [32] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: type
params.description: The type of template to retrieve (scan, policy, or remediation).

items.docs:
Gets details for the specified template.
Requires the Standard [32] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: policy_id
params.description: The ID of the policy to look up.

params.name: family_id
params.description: The ID of the family to lookup within the policy.

params.name: plugin_id
params.description: The ID of the plugin to lookup within the family.

items.docs:
Gets the details of the plugin associated with the scan or policy.
Requires the Standard [32] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: type
params.description: The type of template to retrieve (scan or policy).

params.name: object_id
params.description: The unique ID of the object.

params.name: file_id
params.description: The ID of the file to export.

items.docs:
Downloads the specified custom audit file associated with the scan or policy. The file ID can be found in the scan or policy details using the /editor/{type}/{object_id} endpoint.
Requires Can Execute [32] scan template (policy) permissions. See [Permissions](doc:permissions).
